def partition(items, predicate):
    """Separate items using one decision per input item."""
    return ([item for item in items if predicate(item)],
            [item for item in items if not predicate(item)])
import unittest
from datetime import date

        from catalog import relative_indentation as core
        self.assertEqual(core.dedent_lines(["  a","  b"]), ["a","b"])

    def test_single_pass_partition(self):
        from catalog import single_pass_partition as core
        self.assertEqual(core.partition([1,2,3],lambda n:n%2==0), ([2],[1,3]))

        from catalog import tag_normalization_api as api

        from catalog import strict_column_projection_api as api

    def test_saturday_weekend(self):
        from catalog import saturday_weekend as core
        self.assertTrue(core.is_weekend(6))
